# Locally served graph dependencies

- ELK.js 0.12.0: `elk-api.js`, `elk-worker.min.js`; upstream <https://github.com/kieler/elkjs>. Package license: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later; see ELK-LICENSE.md.
- D3 7.9.0: `d3.min.js`; upstream <https://github.com/d3/d3>. Package license: ISC; see D3-LICENSE.

Files are unmodified release assets from these pinned npm packages. They are bundled with the Python package so Studio graph layouts work without a CDN or an npm install. `checksums.json` records the vendored file hashes.
